/* saleson.shop.item.ItemFrontMapper.getFrontItemCount 답례품 전체 목록 개수 조회 */
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM OP_ITEM I JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON S.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE JOIN OP_ITEM_CATEGORY IC ON I.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID JOIN OP_CATEGORY C ON IC.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID JOIN OP_CATEGORY_GROUP G ON C.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID = G.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM_OPTION_SOLDOUT T ON I.ITEM_ID = T.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND I.PRIVATE_TYPE IN ('000') AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' AND C.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' AND G.CATEGORY_GROUP_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY I.ITEM_ID )

/* saleson.shop.item.ItemFrontMapper.getFrontItemList 답례품 전체 목록 조회 */
SELECT I.ITEM_ID, I.SELLER_ID, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_USER_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_SUMMARY, I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_NEW_FLAG, I.ITEM_LABEL, I.ITEM_TYPE1, I.ITEM_TYPE2, I.ITEM_TYPE3, I.ITEM_TYPE4, I.ITEM_TYPE5, I.ITEM_TYPE6, I.ITEM_TYPE7, I.ITEM_TYPE8, I.ITEM_TYPE9, I.ITEM_TYPE10, I.SOLD_OUT, I.STOCK_FLAG, I.STOCK_QUANTITY, I.TAX_TYPE,
I.ITEM_PRICE, I.COST_PRICE, I.SUPPLY_PRICE, I.SALE_PRICE,
I.ADULT_ITEM_YN, I.MOBILE_ITEM_YN,
I.ITEM_IMAGE, I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG, I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE1, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE2, I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE3, I.DATA_STATUS_CODE, I.DISPLAY_FLAG,
I.STOCK_CODE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_AUTO_FLAG, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TYPE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_DATE, I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TEXT, I.ORDER_MIN_QUANTITY, I.ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY, I.SALE_QUANTITY,
I.CREATED_DATE, IC.CATEGORY_ID, ( CASE WHEN I.SOLD_OUT = '1' THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'N' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE = 'T' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND T.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AS ITEM_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, IFNULL(T.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG,'N') AS ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, S.SELLER_NAME, S.LOGIN_ID AS SELLER_LOGIN_ID, S.COMPANY_NAME AS SELLER_COMPANY_NAME, S.COMMISSION_RATE AS SELLER_COMMISSION_RATE, S.LOCGOV_CODE, CONCAT(L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM,' ',L.LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM FROM OP_ITEM I JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON S.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE JOIN OP_ITEM_CATEGORY IC ON I.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID JOIN OP_CATEGORY C ON IC.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID JOIN OP_CATEGORY_GROUP G ON C.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID = G.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM_OPTION_SOLDOUT T ON I.ITEM_ID = T.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND I.PRIVATE_TYPE IN ('000') AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' AND C.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' AND G.CATEGORY_GROUP_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY I.ITEM_ID
ORDER BY RANDOM()
